violated_contract: A periodic job that walks a per-user registry on behalf of an external integration must not start that sweep unless the integration's credentials are configured for the deployment. Gating the sweep only on wall clock means every execution inside a cadence window launches a full serial registry sweep whose per-user work is guaranteed to fail (the OAuth token refresh rejects unconfigured clients, and a fallback without its API key crashes), so job CPU scales with registry size times window overlap while delivering nothing.
canonical_prevention: Gate the sweep call site on the integration's configured-credentials check in addition to the cadence clock, admit at most one sweep per window with a Redis NX lock keyed by UTC date and window index, skip unkeyed fallback paths, and treat unset credentials as a non-retryable condition; cover every gate with a focused unit test.
